This is a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C., 1973 seeking quashing of FIR No. 523/2013 under Sections 498A/406 IPC, 1860 registered at PS : Mangol Puri, Delhi on the basis of settlement having been arrived at between the parties by virtue of the orders passed by

sentences.text: According to the terms of the settlement, a sum of Rs. 2,75,000/- was to be paid by the petitioner to respondent No.2.
In the interregnum, a sum of Rs. 2 lakhs has already been paid to the respondent No.2.
6. Learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 also affirms the aforesaid submissions of the petitioner.

7. The balance payment of Rs. 75,000/- is being paid by the petitioner to the respondent No.2 in Court today by way of a Demand Draft bearing DD No. 404031 dated 21.03.2023 revalidated on 19.07.2023 drawn on Indian Bank, Sonia Vihar.
8.

The marriage between the petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 have been dissolved by way of a decree of divorce under Section 13B HMA, 1955, a copy whereof is placed at page 43 of the present petition.
9. The I.O. is present in person and identifies the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2, who are present in Court.
So far as petitioner Nos. 2 to 4 are concerned, the I.O. has confirmed their identities over a video call.
In any case, the Aadhaar Cards of respondent Nos. 2 to 4 are also placed on record.
10. This Court has interacted with respondent No.2, who submits that she is well aware of the terms of settlement and affirms the This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 22/09/2023 at 21:24:32 receipt of the full and final settlement amount and she has no objection in case
the present FIR is quashed
This Court has perused the terms of settlement agreement and they appear to be lawful.
The parties are bound by the terms of the settlement.

12. After observing that the disputes are arising from matrimonial ties, this Court is of the considered opinion that no purpose would be served in continuing with the FIR in question and the further criminal proceedings and it would be in the interest of justice as also of the parties and the society that quietus is put to such disputes.
13.
Accordingly, FIR No. 523/2013 under Sections 498A/406 IPC, 1860 registered at PS : Mangol Puri, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom are hereby quashed.
14. The petition along with pending applications is disposed of accordingly.
15. Order Dasti.
TUSHAR RAO GEDELA, J SEPTEMBER 18, 2023/
